The primary figure is a student using the supplied reference for facial appearance and hair. Her left hand grips the near-left wooden rail and her right hand grips the near-right rail, lifting the screen toward its far-edge hinge clamps. The tilted mesh rises above a flat sheet of paper taped to the table, revealing a freshly printed cobalt wave and coral sun with crisp edges. Show the two hand-to-rail contacts, the hinges, the screen-to-paper gap and the wet print together. Her shoulders incline slightly over the desk while both feet support her on the classroom floor. A second fictional 19-year-old student stands beside the table, one palm resting on the desk, her other index finger pointing above a clean edge of the revealed print. The main student's concentrated gaze follows that fingertip to the paper; a small relieved smile is beginning as they recognize that the print worked. Regular school chairs and school bags remain visibly pushed under neighboring desks. Use a horizontal three-quarter medium-wide view from the open end of the table, with the main face, both hands, tilted screen and entire printed sheet large enough to read together. Soft late-afternoon window light crosses her face and illuminates the paper; retain ordinary skin texture, worn desk edges and slight ink stains on the frame. Natural photographic perspective, restrained color and moderate depth of field keep the printing partnership clear while the recognizable classroom stays legible.
